DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSES OF CANCER OF THE CERVIX
Differential Diagnoses
Endometrial cancer, endometrial hyperplasia, endometrial polyps, cervicitis, cervical polyps, cervical erosion
Vaginal lesions: vaginitis, vaginal malignancy
Iatrogenic vaginal/uterine bleeding: hormonal drugs and IUCD in-situ,
Blood disorders: bleeding dyscrasias, leukaemia
